definitions.explanation: A fake or fraudulently made banknote intended to look like genuine currency. Manufacturing and using counterfeit money is a criminal offense.

examples.japanese: {偽札|にせさつ}が{見|み}つかった。
{偽札|にせさつ}を{使|つか}うのは{犯罪|はんざい}だ。
examples.english: Using counterfeit money is a crime.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{紙幣|しへい}には{偽札|にせさつ}{防止|ぼうし}のための{技術|ぎじゅつ}が{多|おお}く{使|つか}われている。
examples.english: Many anti-counterfeiting technologies are used in the new banknotes.

notes:
USAGE:
Also read as {偽札|ぎさつ} in more formal or legal contexts. Japan has a very low rate of counterfeiting compared to many other countries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偽札|にせさつ}{防止|ぼうし} (counterfeit prevention)
- {偽札|にせさつ}を{作|つく}る (to make counterfeit bills)
- {偽札|にせさつ}{事件|じけん} (counterfeiting incident)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {偽造|ぎぞう}{紙幣|しへい}: forged banknote (more formal term)
